author: JoeHoardical
body: Miner_Man has been temp banned by [Removed] for Team Spleefing. But Miner_Man, (my personal friend) has said the spleef happened once and was accidental. Shouldn't these so called Mods show care in their work? If you see someone do something against the rules once, assume they did it accidentally and warn them. If they do it twice, than their gilty, and kick them. If they do it three times, temp ban. I've seen that mods, especially [Removed] has shown a very unprofessional use of their power. This should be taken seriously and have prompt action. Please free Miner_Man, for he is innocent.
